topic: Myth: mining uses only fossil fuels
title: Myth: Bitcoin Mining Uses Only Fossil Fuels
hook: Myth: Bitcoin mining runs only on fossil fuels.

scenes.narration: Cambridge put sustainable energy at fifty-two point four percent of mining's energy mix.
That breaks down as forty-two point six percent renewables and nine point eight percent nuclear.
Natural gas was thirty-eight point two percent. Coal fell to eight point nine percent, down from thirty-six point six in 2022.

cta: Surprised by that? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Cambridge's 2025 report: 52.4% sustainable, 38.2% gas and 8.9% coal.

sources.title: Cambridge Judge Business School: energy mix study
